summary: Sprint rollup at HEAD 28f7942: 34 raw peer findings, ~29 unique after cross-agent dedup. Two cross-agent BLOCKERs (pipeline persistence still 7/9 broken — 3rd cycle, agent-loop-stalled; orphan-section pattern unanimous between fcc-auditor A-001 + compliance F-001/F-002 — also 3rd cycle) plus one single-agent BLOCKER (devsecops persisted 0-byte audit — safe_prod_write gates unverifiable). Engine triplet untouched. Rolled into 4 PR clusters per program-director PD-003 plan.

findings.title: Pipeline persistence still 7/9 broken at HEAD 28f7942 — META-001 contract landed but harness Write gate still denied per-call; 3rd cycle hits agent-loop-stalled
findings.recommended_fix: META-001 (canonical findings contract) shipped in 28f7942 — the code is correct, but the harness-level Write(agents/<agent>/**) permission is still gated per-call and 7 peers declined to persist this cycle. (a) Add persistent allowlist to agents/settings.json. (b) Add a fail-loud post-condition in agents/scripts/run-agent.sh that exits non-zero when agents/<agent>/last-findings.json is missing at end of run. Per agent.md 'Stop conditions', findings_repeat >= 3 runs reaches agent-loop-stalled.
tests_required: agents/scripts/run-agent.sh — exits non-zero when agents/<agent>/last-findings.json absent at end of run
agents/settings.json — Write allowlist covers all ten agents' directories
bash agents/scripts/create-issues-from-findings.sh --dry-run produces >0 valid JSON inputs across all agents
findings.reproducibility_notes: ls -la agents/*/last-findings.json at HEAD 28f7942 returns only agents/program-director/last-findings.json — and that file's head_sha field is 6a25ce7, i.e. one cycle stale.

findings.title: Cross-agent BLOCKER (3rd cycle, unanimous) — orphan-section pattern in engineeringReport renderer: build-attestation + RF-exposure (§1.1310 / OET-65) + tower-study (§17.4) section builders exist but are never imported by engineeringReport/index.js; downstream EVR-001 figure-numbering symptom is the same root cause
findings.recommended_fix: PR-RENDER: import all three section builders into engineeringReport/index.js and add them to the build pipeline. Snapshot tests must assert every Genoa exhibit type renders all three sections with non-empty bodies. Co-sign: program-director + fcc-auditor + compliance-officer.
tests_required: test/exports/engineeringReport/index.test.js — assert all three builders present in rendered FM / LPFM / AM exhibits
findings.reproducibility_notes: fcc-auditor A-001 (BLOCKER, 'systemic orphaned-section pattern'); compliance F-001 (HIGH, OET-65 §1.1310); F-002 (HIGH, §17.4). EVR-001 is downstream. A-001 in 3rd cycle.

findings.title: Single-agent BLOCKER — devsecops-agent persisted 0-byte last-report.md and no last-findings.json this cycle; crash_loop / secrets_changed / migration_without_rollback gates UNVERIFIABLE → blocks safe_prod_write per agent.md
findings.recommended_fix: Re-run devsecops-agent and ensure both last-report.md and last-findings.json are persisted. Empty audit means three safe_prod_write gates cannot be evaluated against HEAD 28f7942.
findings.reproducibility_notes: wc -c agents/devsecops-agent/last-report.md returns 1 (single newline); agents/devsecops-agent/last-findings.json does not exist.
